BiblicalUsage: Chocen is wealth, the treasure a person piles up, and the prophets and proverbs weigh it against what lasts. The prophets of Jerusalem devour souls and take treasure, Jeremiah says God will give all the wealth of the city into the enemy's hand, Isaiah says the fear of the Lord is the true treasure, and the proverb says the house of the righteous holds much treasure.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe wealth in these verses is always tested, and the only treasure that survives the test is the fear of the Lord. I hold that a full house without God is poorer than an empty one with Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
